critical_evidence.evidence: Carfax shows oil changes only. Gaps: 03/2022 (17,636) to 02/2024 (29,208), and 02/2024 to the 09/2026 dealer PDI, with no reported oil entry. No reported entry for brake fluid at any point in about 6.5 years, nor coolant, MT or diff fluid. These are no reported entries, not proof the work was skipped.

The early-6MT failure risk covers 2016/early-2017 builds; this is a 2020 ND2 with the revised gearbox. Carfax shows no reported transmission entries. Shift quality (warm 2nd/3rd) should still be checked at PPI.

No lifted-carpet or behind-seat drain photos. Captured photos show leaves/organic debris on the passenger floor edge and sill area and dirty carpets, which is relevant to RF targa/rear drain clogging.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is solid: VIN, a matching VIN decode, a full Carfax with 2 owners and guaranteed clean brands, consistent odometer readings, and a stated price including fees. The maintenance half is thin: quick-lube oil entries only, two multi-year gaps, no reported fluid services by time, no invoices, and no photos of drains, underside or tire dates.

condition.rationale: No mechanical fault is stated. Photos show cosmetic wear and neglect: dirty carpets with leaf debris, stains on the passenger seat cushion, and worn shift-knob leather. Combined with four Michigan winters and no evidence of time-based fluid service, this sits slightly below the unknown default. Nothing proves good condition.

price_value.rationale: The $25,596 asking price is above the fair-value band of $22,292–$24,646 (mid $23,587). There is an open recall and likely catch-up service. Peer 2019 GT-S RFs are asking about the same money.

mission_fit.rationale: This is a manual ND2 RF from a dealer, available now: reliable, a sealed roof for year-round rain use, and easy to resell. The price is inside the $27,000 ceiling but above the $24,000 ideal high. Gaps in time-based service records keep it from a decisive fit.

logistics.rationale: Cleveland, TN is a fly-and-drive or shipping trip from Pacific Grove. PPI access is unstated, so a mobile inspector would need to be arranged before money moves. CA registration and smog look feasible for a 2020 49-state car over 7,500 mi.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Desirable traits: ND2 181 hp engine, 6MT, RF, and Club hardware (Bilstein/LSD inferred). Against that: black cloth interior rather than Auburn or gray, not GT/GT-S leather, and the gray looks like Polymetal rather than the preferred Machine Gray (to be confirmed).

ppi_focus: Underside corrosion from Michigan winters: subframes, brake and fuel lines, suspension fasteners, rear diff, exhaust hangers
Cabin water ingress: lift carpets, check underlay dampness, seat-rail bolt corrosion, RF rear drains and targa seal drains (debris visible in photos)
RF roof: cycle it several times, check for hesitation, rattles or misalignment, and do a water test on targa seals if possible
Brake fluid moisture test, pad and rotor thickness, and rotor surface condition (rust seen on rear rotor)
Clutch engagement point and slip in 4th-6th, and warm-shift quality into 2nd/3rd
Tire DOT dates and wear pattern, plus alignment readings
Engine bay: water pump weep hole, valve cover and front crank seal seepage, diff pinion and output seals
Scan all modules for stored codes, and confirm recall 24V-695 status by VIN
Body: front lip and air dam scrapes, nose chips, aluminum hood and fender dents, evidence of respray
Bilstein dampers for leaks; listen for end-link or bushing clunks

Up: a negotiated price into or below the $22,292–$24,646 fair-value band
Down: significant underside corrosion, evidence of water ingress, or RF roof faults at inspection
Down: refusal of a mobile PPI or added fees beyond the stated $25,596
evidence.mission_note: A manual ND2 RF is squarely the car he is targeting for a rain-capable, year-round fun daily. The weaker spec (black cloth Club, likely not Machine Gray), above-fair pricing and thin time-based service records make it a solid but unremarkable example rather than the ideal one.
evidence.rationale: The Carfax and VIN decode establish a 2020 ND2 MX-5 RF Club with a 6-speed manual, two personal owners (Ohio, then four years in Michigan), no reported accidents or title brands, and odometer readings consistent with the 36,986 mi photo. Observed issues: the airbag control module recall 24V-695 is open, and the service history is quick-lube oil changes only, with no reported entry between 03/2022 and 02/2024 or since 02/2024. There is no reported brake fluid, coolant, MT or diff fluid service in about 6.5 years. Interior photos show dirty carpets with leaf debris near the passenger sill, a stained seat cushion and worn shift-knob leather, which together point to clogged-drain and water checks. The $25,596 asking price is above the $22,292–$24,646 fair-value band. Still open: underside corrosion after Michigan winters, tire and battery dates, RF roof function, the exact paint code, and whether the dealer will allow a mobile PPI.
evidence.next_action: Call CarsNow to confirm they will allow a mobile PPI at the lot and confirm the out-the-door price in writing, and in the same call ask for tire DOT-date, underside and lifted-carpet photos plus the 09/28/2026 Precision Masters PDI invoice.
